name: Sanity
description: Sanity lets agents run GROQ queries, read and edit documents, and search the Sanity docs in the projects of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Sanity account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the blog posts published this month in my production dataset.
Write a GROQ query for all products that have no image.
Draft a new article document titled "Spring release notes".

apps.name: Sanity
apps.description: GROQ queries, documents, and docs search, over Sanity's MCP server with browser sign-in.
